contract: POST /api/podcasts/opml/create is admin-only and answers 200 immediately: it validates that feeds is a non-empty array of URLs (400), that libraryId and folderId are present (400) and that the folder exists in that library (404), then starts the asynchronous OPML import. The import fetches each feed, skips feeds that fail or resolve to an existing item path, creates the podcast folder named after the sanitized feed title, writes the podcast and library item in one transaction with the feed metadata (categories as genres, feed URL, itunes image as imageUrl, language and itunes ids forced to the empty string, explicit false), the posted autoDownloadEpisodes flag and the server episode schedule, downloads the feed image into the item folder, emits item_added per created podcast and finishes the opml-import task.
evidence: go-backend/testmachine/scenarios/podcast_feed: the four import scenarios pass against pinned upstream in two consecutive full packet runs
exceptions: force is not applicable: the import has no force/override parameter; an existing item path is skipped.

The import transaction-failure branch (PodcastManager.js:664-681) and the folder-creation-failure branch (PodcastManager.js:596-612) are unexecuted: they need a database write or filesystem failure no request input reaches.
The 200 response body is the reason phrase Express sends for sendStatus(200); clients read the status only, so the scenarios assert the status.

invariants.contract: POST /api/podcasts/opml/create answers 401 without a token, 403 for a non-admin, 400 when feeds is not a non-empty array of valid URLs or libraryId or folderId is missing, and 404 when the folder id is unknown or belongs to another library; a rejected request imports nothing.

A valid request answers 200 and, when the opml-import task finishes, has created one library item per feed under <folder>/<sanitized feed title> with mediaType podcast holding the feed title, author, sanitized description, categories as genres, the requested feed URL as feedUrl, the itunes image as imageUrl, releaseDate/language/itunesPageUrl/itunesId/itunesArtistId as empty strings, explicit false, no episodes, the posted autoDownloadEpisodes and the server episode schedule, plus the downloaded cover.jpg as a library file when the feed image is reachable; each created item emits item_added.

Importing the same URLs again answers 200 without a second item, without an item_added and without changing the stored podcast; an import list mixing an unreachable feed, an existing feed and a new feed creates exactly the new item (with autoDownloadEpisodes false and no cover when its image cannot be fetched) and leaves the earlier import untouched.
